body.name: Exact finite tube Bayes calculation
body.construction:
For every \(r\in\mathcal R_{n,3}\) and realized success count \(x^{\mathrm{obs}}\), define \(D_{r,x}=\sum_m
u_{n,\varepsilon,T}^\dagger(m)P_m(x^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid r)\), \(N_{r,x}=\sum_m
u_{n,\varepsilon,T}^\dagger(m)P_m(x^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid r)	au_{c^\dagger}(m)\), and \(S_{r,x}^\dagger=N_{r,x}^2/D_{r,x}\) when \(D_{r,x}>0\), with \(S_{r,x}^\dagger=0\) otherwise. Exact arithmetic is performed in the ordered field \(\mathbb Q(\alpha_n)\). Then \[\mathcal B_{n,\varepsilon,T}^\dagger(r)=\sum_m
u_{n,\varepsilon,T}^\dagger(m)	au_{c^\dagger}(m)^2-\sum_{x^{\mathrm{obs}}}S_{r,x}^\dagger,\qquad B_{n,\varepsilon,T}^\dagger=\min_{r\in\mathcal R_{n,3}}\mathcal B_{n,\varepsilon,T}^\dagger(r).\]
